blocks.markdown: **No administrative, criminal, or civil proceedings** lie against any person for having made a **CTR or STR in the regular performance of duties and in good faith**, whether or not the report results in any criminal prosecution under the AMLA or any other Philippine law. In plain English: a covered person acting in good faith and doing its normal reporting duty is protected **merely for filing** a covered- or suspicious-transaction report — even if no prosecution follows. The protection is tied to **good-faith reporting, not to malicious or fabricated accusations**.

For class, note both the syllabus citation and the official numbering, and confirm whether the instructor intended an earlier IRR version.
